source_name: NBS registre — registers of supervised entities incl. PSD2 register
why_relevant: Adjacent but essential for entity verification in this cell: tells you which of the payments actors found in ORSR/RÚZ are licensed institutions (banks, platobné inštitúcie, agents of PSD2 providers, e-money issuers) versus plain technology vendors — a distinction that changes how a competitor should be classified. registre.nbs.sk provides the searchable register portal, updated daily from source databases.

source_name: Apify 'Finstat.sk Company Data Scraper' — third-party extraction actor
why_relevant: Evidence that third-party scraping tooling for FinStat exists; relevant mainly as a legal/ethical caution marker for the collection design — the compliant path for FinStat data is the licensed API, not a scraper. Listed so the decision is explicit rather than accidental.

source_name: Slovenská banková asociácia (SBA) — official site
why_relevant: The only body representing banks in SK; ~24 member banks covering ~99% of the sector. Its membership page enumerates the entire addressable bank universe in one place, and the site hosts positions, statistics and standards work.

source_name: SBA — Projekty a štandardy (projects and standards)
why_relevant: Sector-level standards and joint projects (payments, instant payments, e-ID/authentication, data exchange) name the schemes and technical standards SK banks are adopting — the closest thing to a public roadmap of collective bank IT initiatives.

source_name: SBA — Tlačové správy (press releases) and Štatistiky a analýzy
why_relevant: Sector commentary and recurring statistics (e.g. payment-card issuance and acceptance series compiled with NBS data from SBA members) give both market-context and named-project signals.

source_name: SBA Educa (association training arm)
why_relevant: Association-run certification/exams for financial intermediaries; course catalogues and lecturer lists indirectly reveal which systems, regulations and vendors are considered mainstream in SK banking.

source_name: ITAS — IT Asociácia Slovenska, member directory
why_relevant: Largest SK ICT association, 100+ member companies, filterable by category (infrastructure/cybersecurity, system integration/software, telco, vendor/distributor, consulting). This is the single best enumeration of the IT vendor and integrator universe that sells into SK banks.

source_name: ITAS — news, position papers and working groups
why_relevant: ITAS statements on eGovernment, cybersecurity (NIS2), AI and procurement name the standards and systems being adopted, and reveal which member firms lead which agenda.

source_name: SAPIE — Slovak Alliance for Innovation Economy, member lists
why_relevant: ~200 member companies/organisations across the innovation and digital-economy ecosystem, split into regular and associated members; captures fintech and digital challengers that ITAS misses.

source_name: LobbyFacts / EU Transparency Register entries for SK associations
why_relevant: Transparency-register datacards disclose association budgets, declared members, lobbying priorities and EU files followed — a cross-check on self-published member lists and on which regulatory topics associations actually spend money on.

source_name: AmCham Slovakia — members directory and committees
why_relevant: Directory of members (annually updated, with business descriptions) plus ~15 committees/working groups (Digital Committee, Tax, Public Procurement, Rule of Law). Membership and sponsorship of AmCham events is a weak but real signal of who sells into SK financial services.

source_name: British Chamber of Commerce in the Slovak Republic (Britcham) — members
why_relevant: ~120 member companies; UK-linked financial services and consultancies active in SK. Complements AmCham for a different vendor cohort.

source_name: Slovensko-nemecká obchodná a priemyselná komora (AHK Slowakei / DSIHK)
why_relevant: ~375 member companies across sectors including services and finance; German-linked vendors and banks (and their SK subsidiaries) surface here. Board/officer roles are explicitly split by function including finance.

source_name: SBCB — Slovak Banking Credit Bureau (operator of SRBI register)
why_relevant: Bank-owned credit bureau (founded by Slovenská sporiteľňa, VÚB, Tatra banka with CRIF); ~17 member institutions. The member list enumerates lending institutions, and the CRIF relationship is a named vendor dependency in SK bank credit infrastructure.

source_name: NBCB — Non Banking Credit Bureau (operator of NRKI)
why_relevant: Interest association of non-bank lenders (~32 members) operating the NRKI register and exchanging data with SRBI since 2015. Its member list maps the non-bank consumer-credit and leasing universe — a distinct buyer segment for POS/credit systems.

source_name: ALS SR — Asociácia leasingových spoločností Slovenskej republiky, riadni členovia
why_relevant: ~32 bank-owned, independent and captive leasing/instalment companies plus associated members; publishes quarterly volume press releases (EUR 3.357bn financed in 2023). Enumerates a whole adjacent financial-institution buyer segment.

source_name: SLASPO — Slovenská asociácia poisťovní, členovia
why_relevant: Insurance association with member categories (riadni, pridružení, stáli pridružení, osobitný štatút); the associated-member tiers typically include service providers and vendors selling into insurers — a direct vendor-discovery lever. Bancassurance links insurers to the bank universe.

source_name: Slovenská kancelária poisťovateľov (SKP)
why_relevant: Statutory bureau of motor insurers, closely tied to SLASPO (shared LinkedIn presence). Membership is compulsory for MTPL insurers, so its list is an authoritative census of that segment; it also procures shared IT systems.

source_name: SASS — Slovenská asociácia správcovských spoločností
why_relevant: 7 full and ~18 associated members in collective investment; the associated-member tier is where custodians, distributors and IT/data vendors appear. Bank-owned asset managers link back to the bank universe.

source_name: FINAS — Fintech & Insurtech Asociácia Slovenska
why_relevant: Active fintech/insurtech association with a membership page; enumerates the challenger and technology-provider cohort that neither SBA nor SLASPO covers.

source_name: Slovenská FinTech asociácia (Slovak FinTech Association)
why_relevant: Interest association of legal entities (founded 2018, IČO 51910497) bridging financial services and IT; officers and events point to active fintech vendors. Public member list appears thin, so FinStat/Transparex records of its founding members are the workaround.

source_name: Blockchain Slovakia — members
why_relevant: Named member list for the crypto/blockchain cohort in SK; relevant for MiCA-driven bank-adjacent activity and for identifying firms positioning around digital assets and tokenised payments.

source_name: Digitálna koalícia (National Coalition for Digital Skills and Jobs) — members and commitments
why_relevant: ~83-100 members each publishing declared commitments (232 commitments recorded); members include banks and IT firms, and the commitment texts name concrete digital projects and partners — an unusually specific pointer to who is doing what with whom.

source_name: Register záujmových združení právnických osôb SR (MV SR)
why_relevant: Authoritative state register of 'záujmové združenia právnických osôb' — the legal form most SK banking/IT associations use. Gives founding members, statutory bodies and statutes even when an association publishes no member list.

source_name: FinStat / Transparex company and association records
why_relevant: Financial and event history for associations themselves (ITAS IČO 31801412, SASS 31792537, SLASPO 17054303, AHK 30848717, Digitálna koalícia 52828123). Reveals officer changes, revenue scale and — via 'udalosti' feeds — governance shifts that precede agenda changes.

source_name: Vendor 'partneri/členstvo' pages citing association membership (e.g. sféra, a.s.; Erste AM)
why_relevant: Vendors advertise their association memberships on their own sites; reverse-searching phrases like 'člen IT Asociácie Slovenska' or 'člen SBA' surfaces members that directories omit and confirms self-declared positioning in banking/finance.

source_name: ITAPA - Slovak IT & digitalisation congress (itapa.sk)
why_relevant: Slovakia's oldest and largest public-sector/IT congress. Partner tiers, EXPO-zone exhibitor rosters and speaker affiliations are a paid, dated declaration of which integrators and technology vendors are selling into SK public and financial digitalisation. Archive of past editions allows multi-year sponsor trend analysis.

source_name: Cena ITAPA (ITAPA Award) - shortlists and winning digital projects
why_relevant: Annual award for digitalisation projects; entries name the delivering supplier alongside the client organisation, which is one of the few public places where a SK vendor-client delivery pair is stated. 2025 edition had a record 43 entries. Weak-signal early indicator of who delivered what, months before any case study.
